# captured from: generacy --version 0.0.1
Usage: generacy cockpit watch [options] <epic-ref>

Emit one NDJSON line per issue/PR state transition. Pure sensor.

Arguments:
  epic-ref          Epic ref. Accepts <n>, <owner>/<repo>#<n>, or
                    https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>.

Options:
  --interval <ms>   Poll interval in ms (default 30000, floor 15000).
  --safety-cap <n>  Warn when per-poll item count exceeds this (default 1000).
  -h, --help        display help for command
